page: Microsoft Azure D4pds_v6 is a general-purpose virtual machine based on the 64-bit ARM architecture. The instance is powered by dedicated ARM Neoverse-N2 cores operating at a base frequency of 3.4 GHz. It provides 4 physical cores and 4 vCPUs without simultaneous multithreading, backed by 64 KB L1 data cache, 1 MB L2 cache, and a shared 128 MB L3 cache. Memory capacity is configured at 16.0 GB of RAM, preserving a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio of 4.0 GB per core. Local scratch storage is bundled with a 236 GB NVMe SSD, providing low-latency ephemeral I/O alongside support for Premium Storage.

Benchmark results place the D4pds_v6 consistently in the mid-range for general-purpose compute and memory workloads. The instance achieves average ratings across stress-ng single-core (2,073.38) and multi-core (8,274.75) suites, as well as Geekbench single-core (1,699.0) and multi-core (5,596.0) tests. Single-threaded gzip compression demonstrates strong performance at 33.1 GB/sec. Conversely, PassMark cryptographic and extended instruction evaluations show lower-tier throughput, and ray tracing benchmarks register within the bottom quartile, reflecting limitations in specific non-vectorized and specialized execution paths.

Data handling and networking benchmarks align with standard enterprise requirements, showing 8.39 million operations per second in Redis SET operations and a static web serving throughput of 7.95 GB/sec. Uncached read memory bandwidth achieves 90.31 GB/sec, while write operations reach 39.29 GB/sec. Machine learning tasks show notable bottlenecks; large language model text generation achieves only 5.11 tokens/sec on medium 7B models, underscoring the lack of discrete acceleration hardware.

Qualitatively, the D4pds_v6 delivers solid resource efficiency for workloads optimized for ARM-native architectures, providing dedicated core isolation and high cache density without hyperthreading contention. It is appropriate for mid-tier web serving, continuous integration environments, caching servers, and lightweight relational or document databases utilizing local NVMe storage.
description: Microsoft Azure D4pds_v6 is a general-purpose virtual machine equipped with 4 dedicated ARM Neoverse-N2 cores running at 3.4 GHz and 16.0 GB of memory, delivering a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio. Built on 64-bit ARM architecture, the system includes 236 GB of local NVMe SSD storage and a 128 MB L3 cache. In benchmark tests, the instance delivers steady mid-tier performance across multi-core integer processing, code compilation, and memory operations, alongside strong gzip compression throughput. However, workloads relying on specialized mathematical extensions, complex cryptography, or LLM inference show reduced efficiency due to the absence of hardware accelerators. With dedicated execution threads and fast temporary local storage, the D4pds_v6 represents a balanced option for running ARM-native web services, microservices, continuous integration pipelines, Redis caching clusters, and mid-tier database backends.
